mapper.select: SELECT mapping.id, mapping.subject_hint, mapping.subject_hash, mapping.user_id, u.username, u.real_name, mapping.last_authenticated_at, mapping.create_time FROM ai_capability_external_identity mapping LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = mapping.user_id AND u.tenant_id = mapping.tenant_id AND u.del_flag = 0 WHERE mapping.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND mapping.provider_code = #{providerCode} AND mapping.issuer_hash = #{issuerHash} AND mapping.status = 'ENABLED' AND mapping.del_flag = 0 ORDER BY mapping.create_time DESC, mapping.id DESC

SELECT mapping.id, mapping.subject_hint, mapping.subject_hash, mapping.user_id, u.username, u.real_name, mapping.last_authenticated_at, mapping.create_time FROM ai_capability_external_identity mapping LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = mapping.user_id AND u.tenant_id = mapping.tenant_id AND u.del_flag = 0 WHERE mapping.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND mapping.provider_code = #{providerCode} AND mapping.issuer_hash = #{issuerHash} AND mapping.status = 'ENABLED' AND mapping.del_flag = 0
AND (mapping.subject_hint LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY mapping.create_time DESC, mapping.id DESC
